# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

anyColorPicker is a color picker library for Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform, on Android, iOS, desktop (JVM) and the web (Wasm), and a Jetpack Compose color picker in Android-only apps. `codes.side:colorpicker-material3` holds ready-made Material 3 pickers, sliders, planes, a swatch and a dialog; `codes.side:colorpicker-foundation` holds the same components without Material; `codes.side:color` is the color model alone, built on CSS Color 4. All are on Maven Central. Source and issues: {{ site.github.repository_url }}
